description: Evidence manifest for proving the production platform frontend is deployed with the expected backend configuration, TLS, build identity, cache policy, and secret hygiene.
rules: app_url and backend_base_url must be https URLs and must not point at localhost
deployed and tls_valid must be true
build_sha256 must be 64 lowercase hex characters
environment backend_base_url must match the manifest backend_base_url
secret-like environment values must be redacted
secret_scan.status must be pass and findings must be empty
notes: This validator checks captured frontend deployment metadata only. It does not deploy the frontend, call networks, validate TLS handshakes, or run secret scanners.
